digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler outbound parent field emission and DC hierarchy adapter
propositions: A user's parent edit on a non-epic parent is silently dropped during outbound emit with no log, durable record, or bridge alert, causing the pass to exit 0 while hierarchy divergence remains undetected.

DC accepts and silently ignores PUT fields.parent on a sub-task; clearing a sub-task parent returns 400; sub-task editmeta exposes no parent field — three separate operations confirm sub-task parent is not a supported platform mechanism.

The emit-side suppression (8b25 guard at outbound_field_diff.py:138-139) is indistinguishable from retry-next-pass and fails to record via the existing bridge_alerts apparatus, violating the project's stated contract that divergence must surface durably.

Two live test cells have never passed in 12 consecutive harness runs because they are wrong oracles asserting operations on sub-task parents that the platform cannot perform; re-homing to Epic Link operations on standard issue children uses already-green mechanisms and preserves the subject of each test.
